G1_unambiguity.justification: The purchasing and execution rules clearly define that each regulated pair must be realizable as the sole pair of ledgers with odd marks.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement provides all necessary constraints, input and output formats, cost rules, feasibility guarantee, and the single-regulated-ledger edge case.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Having a purchased procedure set realize an odd-mark state for every regulated pair is equivalent to all regulated vertices being connected in the purchased undirected subgraph, exactly matching the original task.

G4_naturalness.justification: The analogy is coherent and readable, though terms such as “automated reconcilement procedures” and “audit marks” make it somewhat contrived compared with a conventional graph formulation.
